name: computer
title: Computer
summary: Agents work in the apps on your Mac that you allow, in each app's own window and signed in as you. macOS only; one agent at a time, and you can take over.

manifest.name: computer
manifest.description: Lets agents work in the apps on your Mac that you allow, through a small native helper: macOS accessibility and the app’s own window, signed in as you. One agent at a time; you can take over.

network.why: Your apps use their own network and sign-ins; this plugin sends nothing itself. Each app window’s picture and accessibility text go to the agent’s model provider.

tools.name: computer.check
tools.description: Read the computer helper and macOS permissions again; with prompt, put macOS’s own Allow dialogs in front of the owner.

tools.name: computer.add_app
tools.description: Put an app on the list agents may open, by its bundle id or its name.

tools.name: computer.remove_app
tools.description: Take an app off the list agents may open.

tools.name: computer.use_as_browser
tools.description: The listed browser websites open in.

tools.name: computer.set_unlisted
tools.description: What happens when an agent wants an app that is not on the list.

tools.name: computer.set_profile
tools.description: Which of the browser’s profiles websites open in; empty for whichever is in front.

drift: its manifest declares the host * (what the apps you allow reach), which its buddi.md does not mention
